answer: Each identity leases a unique long-lived endpoint, registered as its raven call-sign, and must answer unpredictable nonce pings during a multi-epoch probation or forfeit a locked deposit. Independent auditors posted on a public knoll send those pings and record path delay as the packets travel a declared river of relays. Matching delay fingerprints or a reused call-sign are merged into one identity and the deposit is slashed. An attacker who wants N aliases must provision N separately routed, always-on listeners with distinguishable paths and lock collateral on each, not merely mint N keys.
